description: This source file defines the CustomDirectoryGrain class implementing a Orleans grain with directory attributes, identity, and basic methods including ping, reset, and retrieving runtime instance ID.

classes.name: CustomDirectoryGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class implementing custom directory functionality with methods for pinging, resetting, and getting the silo address.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Increments internal counter and returns its value asynchronously.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counter to zero asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the silo address asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Delegates a ping call to another grain implementing ICommonDirectoryGrain.
